coverage_notes: Every supplied observation and CRA row was considered. Every registered anchor page, including secondary locations, was actually viewed. Context pages and enlarged source plots were consulted where needed. This is alignment of the exact supplied registry, not a full-paper census or proof of the presentation selected by the original curators. Inputs are unchanged.
shared_qualifications: Fig.5 (PDF p.3), enlarged to resolve the clustered Mn points, separates forged open symbols from1050 C water-quenched filled symbols. CRA heat text specifies quenching; supported assignments use only quenched0.1/0.05 N NaCl outcomes. Overlapping forged markers remain separate observations, not shared assignments to quench records.

C1: source plots use mV_H (hydrogen-reference scale). A conditional25 C saturated-KCl comparison is E_mV(SCE)=E_mV(H)-241, using Corrtest SCE=+0.241 V versus NHE at25 C (https://www.corrtestinstruments.com/en/02437.html). The paper does not establish the reference calibration/temperature needed to reproduce the CRA scale exactly. Calculations are illustrative and not fitted to CRA; definitive potential_agreement is not_comparable. Independent composition, quench state and electrolyte identify the proposed rows.

C2: source polarization is stepped50 mV per30 s, giving nominal50/30=1.666667 mV/s, not proof of a continuous sweep (PDF p.1). C3: for the explicitly identified monovalent NaCl, N=mol/L chloride; acid normality does not add chloride. No pH is calculated from H2SO4 normality.
Source tests are25 C in0.1 N H2SO4 with0.01/0.05/0.1 N NaCl (PDF p.1). The0.01 N upward arrows mean no pitting to approximately1150 mV_H, not measured pitting. No0.01 N CRA row is supplied.

Table1 carbon for10% Mn is n.d., not source zero; CRA stores0.0. Mixed austenite/ferrite or martensite/ferrite phases are described in the source; CRA delta-ferrite is not treated as a complete phase census. Source p.2 says most experiments used1 h at1050 C before quenching; the Fig.5 quenched legend does not independently resolve every duration in the broad CRA heat text.

Poppler returned success but reported illegal characters in an ASCIIHex stream on PDF pp.2-3. The relevant text, Fig.5 symbols/axes and Table1 were actually viewed and legible; no registered anchor was blocked.
